description:

- Qualify. Filter what comes in against a clear deal criteria we provide (type, numbers, location). Only the deals worth our time move forward. We need judgment here, not everything dumped on us.

Tools:
, Instagram, LinkedIn, Skool, Close CRM, and a criteria + tone doc we provide. Full training given.



Targets (KPI-tracked):

A weekly target on qualified conversations held A weekly target on qualified deals entered into Close and flagged to the team

The number that matters most is quality deals that progress - not raw outreach volume. We measure the bottom of the funnel.



Hours:

Full-time, 40 hrs/week. Mostly async, so you have flexibility on timing as long as volume and quality hold.



Pay:

- $800-$1,000/month base to start, depending on experience Plus commission on every deal we close that you sourced - meaningful upside on top of base Reviewed at 90 days with clear room to grow for the right person 13th month paid

- This is structured so the better the deals you bring, the more you earn. You're not just running tasks - you've got skin in what we close.

 your application to

title: B2B Content & Social Media Manager (Video + Ads)
description:
Read this first

I'm hiring one person to take over our content, social media and ads. If you're a content creator at heart who likes the marketing game and can ship every day without being chased, keep reading.



About Feight AI

We build custom AI solutions for manufacturers in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. The technical side is now staffed. I run sales, strategy and client relationships myself. What's missing is the engine that produces content, runs the social channels, and brings inbound interest from manufacturing decision-makers.

This is a blank canvas. No content, no funnel, no paid presence yet. The person we hire defines what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch, with me holding the strategic frame and you producing the actual work.

What matters most

The single most important skill is content creation, especially video. Our organic growth across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. You produce content yourself, every day, consistently. That's the heart of this role.

Second to that is marketing sense. Enough to look at our numbers and tell me what's working and what isn't, and enough to have a real conversation about strategy. I hold the strategic frame. You execute and bring proposals.

What you'll be doing day to day



Producing 1 to 2 social posts per day, every working day, across our channels (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, blog). Mix of text, graphics, and video.

Creating short video content regularly. Editing, voiceover, visuals. This is the most important muscle.

Running Meta Ads when we launch them.

Building simple landing pages when needed for campaigns or lead magnets.

Tracking what works. You watch the numbers across channels and tell me what's worth doubling down on.



You probably



Create content yourself as your main skill, especially video. You can show us examples.

Have a marketing brain. Enough strategy sense to discuss what we should try next and why.

Are organized and self-directing. You ship every day without being chased.

Have a strong work ethic. If you say you'll publish something, it goes out, on time, at the quality you promised.

Learn fast. If you don't know LinkedIn Ads or a particular landing page tool yet, you figure it out in a week.

Communicate in English clearly and professionally.

Use AI tools daily for the actual work. We expect this, not just talk about it.

Want to earn more through results, not hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting.



This isn't a fit if



You don't personally create content. You manage other creators or "also write."

You can't be consistent. You need someone to chase you every day to ship.

You're motivated mainly by hourly pay, not by performance.

You expect detailed onboarding and three months to figure out the basics.



What we offer



$1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time.

Performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside.

Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. Today's content + social manager becomes tomorrow's head of marketing with a team.

Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat the people running important parts of our business like partners.

Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move.



To apply

Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped.



Then send us:



A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, why this role caught your attention.

Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video.

One or two examples of B2B or business marketing work you've done before. Show us what you've shipped and the thinking behind it.

Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, video, design, copy, ads, research. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool.



Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person.

Next steps

Here's what happens after you send your application:



We'll get back to you within 5 business days.

If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour.

The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder.



All the best,

FEIGHT AI Team

title: Dropship Dispute Manager — Experience REQUIRED
description:

  payment dispute workflow. Your mission is simple: win disputes,

  processors.

  demonstrably show previous dropship store experience handling

  disputes and chargebacks.

  You'll monitor all incoming chargebacks and disputes daily. Every dispute

  that comes in becomes your responsibility — gathering evidence,

  constructing the response narrative, submitting before deadlines. contact the customer to resolve the issue.

  

  Your evidence packages need to be airtight: delivery proof,

  tracking screenshots, customer communication logs, signed agreements

  where applicable, product descriptions matching what was delivered.

  You know what payment processors look for, and you build responses

  that win.



The highest priority at all times is to contact customers as quickly as possible when a dispute, chargeback, or complaint is received. The goal is to resolve issues directly with the customer before they escalate further.



Because of this, strong customer support experience is essential. You must be able to communicate professionally, clearly, and in a customer friendly manner via
. Excellent written English is required, as a large part of the role involves communicating with customers, resolving concerns, and finding solutions that prevent disputes from escalating.



Performance bonuses are directly linked to successful dispute prevention, customer retention, and resolving customer issues quickly and professionally. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, acts fast, and has a proven track record of reducing chargebacks through proactive customer communication.

  

  You'll track every outcome — which disputes won, which lost, why.

  trigger disputes, which customer segments dispute most, which

  shipping methods cause friendly fraud. You'll feed those patterns

  back to ownership so we can fix the upstream causes, not just chase

  • Detail-oriented and deadline-driven (missed deadline = lost dispute)

  • Long-term stable position with a growing operation

  • BONUS STRUCTURE

  • Clear path for growth — as our volume scales, your scope and

  • Real autonomy — you own the function

title: Long-Form YouTube Editor (Founder Channels, 8-15 Minute Videos)
description:
Editing 8 to 15 minute YouTube videos. Talking head with B-roll, captions, lower thirds, sound design.



Most editors pad. We need one who knows when to cut a 30 second tangent and when to let a 6 second beat breathe. That's the skill we're paying for.



Rate scales with quality (you self-place, trial confirms):



$4/hr — clean technical work, basic pacing

$6/hr — solid narrative judgment, good B-roll cadence

$8/hr — senior pacing chops, restraint, ready to lead a project

Trial brief sent within 24 hours of application. Onboarded inside 7 days if you pass. Weekly volume after that, paid weekly via Wise.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then: portfolio link, software, hours per week. Missing any of these = skipped.

title: Documentary Style Editor (Restrained Pacing, Cinematic Feel)
description:
Hiring an editor with documentary instincts. No jump cut spam, no trending TikTok audio, no fake suspense music, no emojis on screen.



You should be able to watch a doc-style edit and feel when the editor lost faith in the footage and started reaching for tricks. You should know when to hold a 6 second beat and when to cut hard. You should be able to ride a tonal shift mid-clip without flattening it.



If you study Magnus Midtbø, Jimmy Chin, NatGeo, Free Solo, or anything with restraint as a signature, you'll get this.



Trial brief in 24 hours. Roster in 7 days. Weekly work after.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then: portfolio, software, hours per week, and 3 documentary editors or channels you study.

title: Repurposing Editor (Finds the Moments in Long Form)
description:
Most editors transcode. We need one with judgment. Watch a 20 minute video, find the 30 seconds worth keeping, cut it. That's the job.



The skill we're paying for is knowing what to cut OUT. Half of taste is restraint. You should be able to defend every cut you make in one sentence.



You should know what makes someone stop scrolling. You should know the difference between a 
nt that cuts itself and one you have to force.



The trial tests this directly. We give you a 90 second window. You find the 
nt.



Brief in 24 hours of application. Onboarded in 7 days. Weekly volume.



Application must start with your per-clip rate. Then: portfolio, software, hours per week, and 3 channels you watch specifically for repurposing inspiration.

title: Motion Graphics Editor (After Effects, Animated Text + Lower Thirds)
description:
After Effects specialist. Animated text overlays, lower thirds, transitions, brand intros, chapter cards.



You should know when motion adds and when it distracts. You should know the difference between motion design that supports the content and motion design that competes with it. You should know clean typography from busy typography.



We don't want plugin spam. We don't want every transition to be a wipe. We want restrained, intentional motion that serves the cut.



You'll work alongside our base editors who hand off projects for your motion layer.



Trial brief in 24 hours of application. Onboarded in 7 days. 3 to 5 projects per week once active.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then: AE-focused portfolio, software, hours per week, and one motion design trend you think is overrated plus one you think is underrated.

For the edit side: you should know where retention drops and how to fix it.



For the thumbnail side: you should know thumbnail psychology. Why MrBeast's thumbnails work. Why Veritasium's work differently. Why most channels' thumbnails fail at small sizes on a phone.



We want someone who can run a channel's full visual identity, not someone strong on one craft and weak on the other.



3 to 5 deliverables per week (mix of edits and thumbs). Trial brief in 24 hours. Onboarded in 7 days.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then send TWO portfolios (video edits AND thumbnails), software, hours per week, and one thumbnail from a channel you think is underrated.

unior editor with at least 6 months of editing experience. We'll train you on our exact style and workflow.

-------------------------



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will handle customer
 tickets for our Shopify-based ecommerce dropshipping brand. That means working through an inbox of 80 to 100 tickets per shift in Gorgias: order status inquiries, cancellation requests, returns and refunds, damaged or lost package cases, and size or quality complaints. You will use our documented SOPs and reply macros to resolve cases consistently, professionally, and with care.



This is not a chat role, not a phone role, and not a social media role. It is
 ticket handling in Gorgias, every day.



-------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Reply to customer
 tickets in Gorgias using our documented SOPs and reply macros

- Hit team KPIs on First Response Time (FRT) and resolution time

- Coordinate with our Supply Chain and Disputes teams when cases require handoff

- Process refunds, replacements, and partial refunds within the approved decision tree

- Escalate cases that fall outside policy to the CS Manager with a clear summary

- Flag products with recurring complaints to the Quality team on a weekly basis

- Keep clean notes on tickets so handoffs are seamless

-------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE FROM DAY 1



- A full Customer Support SOP covering every scenario you will encounter

- Gorgias reply macros for common situations (cancellations, RTS, damaged items, lost in transit, and more)

- A Risky Products SOP for weekly product quality reporting

- Direct access to the CS Manager for escalations and questions

- An existing CS team to learn from, not a brand new setup

You do not need to invent the playbook. We have built it. You need to execute it cleanly and consistently.



-------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



- Hands-on experience in ecommerce customer support, dropshipping customer support, OR Shopify-based CS (any combination works, dropshipping experience is a strong plus)

- Experience with Gorgias OR a comparable ticketing tool (Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk). Direct Gorgias is preferred but we can train on it quickly if you have strong Zendesk experience.

- Comfort handling 80 to 100 tickets per shift without falling behind

- Strong written English: clear, empathetic, and professional

- Reliable internet and your own computer

Bonus (not required):

- Prior experience handling RTS (return-to-sender) situations

- Familiarity with chargebacks and dispute processes in dropshipping

- Prior experience with EU customers and their return expectations

-------------------------



SCHEDULE - READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



This role is 7 days a week, every week. Our customers
 every day including weekends and public holidays. If you cannot commit to working 7 days a week, please do not apply. We will not make exceptions, and applying anyway only wastes both our time.



You can flex your specific working hours within the day as long as tickets are handled within our FRT target.



-------------------------



COMPENSATION DETAILS



Paid weekly via Wise. Rate grows with performance and tenure, we promote from within for team leads and specialist roles.



-------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected without review.



1. Put the word BAMBU in your subject line. Nothing else is required in the subject.

2. In your application message, answer these 4 questions in order. Answer each inline, no attachments, no Loom videos at this stage.

Q3. What ticketing tools have you used (Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk, etc.)? What ticket volume per shift have you typically handled, and what is the most you have ever handled in a shift?



Q4. Confirm your availability: hours per day, days per week (we need 7), and your working hours in your local timezone. Also confirm: are you currently employed, and if yes, what would your start date look like?



-------------------------



We read every application that follows the instructions. We are looking for one person for the long term, not a roster of temporary help.

ntum.

title: Operations Manager (Credit Repair, Marketing & Real Estate Operations)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We are a dual-pillar business operating at the intersection of real estate acquisition and credit-driven business funding. This is not a coordinator position. You are the operational backbone of two businesses. You will manage talent, oversee execution, own systems, and ensure both pillars perform at a high level — simultaneously. You will be the primary point of contact between leadership and the team. Decisions that used to wait will now have a home with you.

    •    Oversee day-to-day credit repair operations and client fulfillment from onboarding through resolutionEnsure effective use of compliant credit repair methods and workflows across all active client casesManage CRM systems for client onboarding, dispute tracking, and client communicationMonitor KPIs including turnaround times, client progress, and retention ratesImprove and document SOPs to ensure consistency and scalability as the client base grows

    •    Coordinate and oversee marketing execution across all social media platformsEnsure production of high-quality, attention-grabbing short-form content — Reels, clips, viral editsOversee workflows for content batching, editing standards, transitions, hooks, captions, and CTAsAlign all marketing output with lead generation goals, brand standards, and compliance requirementsServe as the operational bridge between marketing content and sales funnels



REAL ESTATE OPERATIONS & VA MANAGEMENT

    •    Manage and communicate with real estate virtual assistants to ensure daily output and accountabilityEnsure accurate property research and market targeting for subject-to and creative finance opportunitiesOversee CRM workflows for real estate lead intake, tracking, and follow-upCoordinate use of tools including Go High Level and Lead Shepherd to manage pipeline activityAct as liaison between leadership and VA teams to maintain performance standards



TALENT SOURCING & TEAM BUILDING

    •    You are the eyes and ears of this organization when it comes to hiring — across every pillar, every role, every verticalActively source, vet, and recruit candidates for open roles across the credit repair arm, real estate arm, and marketing and media arm — without waiting to be directedOwn the full hiring pipeline: job post creation, application review, candidate screening, interviews, and final recommendations to leadershipSource talent through OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, and any other platform necessary to find the right people at the right timeIdentify gaps in the team before they become problems — if a role needs to be filled, you are expected to have candidates in the pipeline proactivelyOnboard all new hires with proper documentation, SOPs, access, and expectations from day oneMonitor new hire performance through a structured probation period and make retention or replacement recommendations accordinglyMaintain a running roster of vetted talent that can be activated when a role opens — the business does not stop for vacancies



SYSTEMS & AUTOMATION

    •    Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and streamline workflows using AI and CRM toolsImplement and optimize CRM automations, pipelines, tagging systems, and reporting dashboardsContinuously improve internal systems and document SOPs as the business scalesServe as the primary point of contact between the founder and the entire team



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



CREDIT REPAIR — EXTENSIVE KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED

    •    Deep, hands-on knowledge of credit repair processes — dispute methods, Metro 2 compliance, goodwill letters, rapid rescore strategies, and credit bureau protocolsAbility to audit a client's credit profile and identify the correct course of action without guidanceExperience managing active credit repair caseloads and ensuring clients move through the pipeline efficientlyIf you cannot perform the work yourself, you must be capable of identifying, hiring, and managing the talent who can — no exceptions



MEDIA & MARKETING — EXTENSIVE KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED

    •    Extensive experience with short-form content creation and strategy — Reels, TikTok-style edits, viral clips, 
s, and carousel postsProficiency with CapCut Pro for video editing — transitions, hooks, captions, sound design, and platform-optimized outputStrong understanding of content batching, scheduling, and maintaining consistent brand voice across platformsKnowledge of what drives engagement, reach, and conversion in the credit repair and real estate nichesAbility to oversee and quality-control a content creator or media VA — and step in to execute if that role is vacantExperience with Meta Ads Manager or paid social campaigns is a strong plus



REAL ESTATE — VAST EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

    •    Extensive real estate operations experience — creative financing, subject-to acquisitions, seller finance, and distressed property targetingHands-on experience with multiple real estate platforms and lead generation portals (see tools list below)Ability to manage and direct VA cold callers, skip tracers, and lead managers toward daily performance targetsStrong understanding of how to identify, qualify, and track motivated seller leads through the full pipelineIf a tool or strategy can improve team performance and pipeline output, you are expected to know it or find it



OPERATIONS & LEADERSHIP

    •    Proven ability to hire, vet, onboard, and manage remote talent across multiple departmentsIf a role is unfilled, the responsibility does not disappear — it falls on you until the right person is in placeStrong SOP development skills — you document everything so the business is never dependent on one personHigh-level proficiency with CRM and automation platforms — Go High Level strongly preferredA-player standard: you own every outcome under your oversight, you hold your team accountable, and you deliver results — not reasons



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

    •    Credit repair clients move smoothly through the system with clear tracking and minimal bottlenecksMarketing content is consistent, high-quality, and aligned with growth goals across both brandsReal estate VAs operate with clear direction, accurate data, and strong accountability to daily targetsEvery open role has qualified candidates in the pipeline before leadership has to askNew hires are onboarded cleanly, perform to standard, and integrate without disrupting operationsSystems are documented, automated, and scalable — not dependent on any single personLeadership is freed from daily operational oversight and focused entirely on growth

title: AI-First Video Editor for Facebook Ads - MUST Know AI Tools (HeyGen, Image Gen, ChatGPT/Claude)
description:
Read this carefully. This is NOT a normal video editing job.



We run a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand and produce
 and Instagram video ads at volume. We want ONE dedicated, long-term editor who is fluent in AI tools. If you can edit but cannot actually use AI to create, this role is not for you. Please do not apply.



You must also be fluent in English. Clear written and spoken English is required, as you will be working closely with us and reading scripts in English.



We write the scripts. Your job is to turn them into finished ads. Your footage will come from many sources: AI generation, stock and online clips, YouTube, Canva, and UGC creators. You need to be comfortable pulling from all of these and blending them into one clean, cohesive ad.



AI is the job. You must already know how to:

. Create talking-head and avatar videos with AI tools such as HeyGen (avatar selection, lip-sync, cleanup).

. Generate B-roll, scenes, and product images with AI image tools such as Nano Banana Pro or Midjourney, including writing precise prompts.

. Use AI tools to build captions and hooks.

. Combine AI footage with sourced footage (stock, YouTube, Canva, UGC) into a finished ad, not just edit clips someone hands you.



On top of AI fluency, you must edit well:

. Cut our scripts into
 and Instagram ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5). Ad length varies widely, anywhere from 10 seconds to 10 minutes, so the skill is knowing where to cut and when, not hitting a fixed runtime.

. Keep it clean and simple. We do NOT want over-edited videos with heavy effects. The right cut at the right 
nt matters far more than fancy transitions.

. Add sound-off captions, music, and SFX where they help, nothing more.

. Nail the first three seconds (the hook) every single time.

. Use direct-response pacing: fast and punchy, NOT slow cinematic montage.

title: Remote Sales & Demo Specialist for U.S. SaaS Company
description:
ShyftGrid is looking for a serious Remote Sales & Demo Specialist to help us grow a U.S.-based SaaS platform for property operators, multi-location businesses, workforce teams, and service companies.



This is a remote position with a guaranteed monthly base plus commission, residual income, and growth bonuses. This is a strong opportunity for someone who speaks professional English, is organized, can follow up consistently, and wants to grow with a company instead of only doing short-term tasks.



ABOUT SHYFTGRID



ShyftGrid is a software platform that helps businesses manage teams, locations, scheduling, shift activity, operations, and workforce accountability. Our pricing is based on monthly recurring revenue, so this role is focused on helping us bring in real paying customers.



This is not just a basic VA job. This role is for someone who can help create sales opportunities, communicate with business owners, book demos, support demos, follow up, and help turn interested prospects into paying monthly customers.



COMPENSATION



Starting monthly base:

$500 USD per month



The monthly base covers the regular daily work:

- Lead research

- Finding qualified businesses

- Outreach

- CRM updates

- Booking demos

- Demo support

- Follow-up

- Customer communication

- Pipeline organization



Commission:

35% of the first month collected revenue from customers you help close.



Residual commission:

5% monthly residual for 12 months while the customer stays active and paying.



Important:

There is no separate demo bonus. Demo booking and demo support are part of the monthly base pay. Commission and bonuses are based on real paying customers, not just demo activity.



MRR BONUS STRUCTURE



Bonuses are based on verified monthly recurring revenue, not just the number of demos.



$2,500 MRR active for 60 days = $250 bonus

$5,000 MRR active for 60 days = $500 bonus

$10,000 MRR active for 60 days = $1,000 bonus

$20,000 MRR active for 60 days = $2,500 bonus

$30,000 MRR active for 60 days = $5,000 bonus



Customers must be real paying businesses. Free trials, refunds, chargebacks, unpaid invoices, or fake accounts do not count.



PAY GROWTH



This position starts at $500/month.



After 60–90 days, base pay may increase based on performance and verified revenue created.



Possible pay growth:

$2,500 MRR created = eligible for $650/month base

$5,000 MRR created = eligible for $750/month base

$10,000 MRR created = eligible for $1,000/month base



Pay increases are not automatic. They are based on real results, CRM tracking, consistent communication, and paying customers.



WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR



This role is ideal for someone who:



- Speaks clear professional English

- Is comfortable communicating with U.S. business owners

- Is organized and consistent

- Can work remotely with minimal supervision

- Understands lead generation and sales follow-up

- Can book and support demo calls

- Can learn software quickly

- Can use a CRM properly

- Is motivated by USD income, commissions, and growth bonuses

- Wants a long-term opportunity, not short-term task work



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will help with:



- Finding property managers, cleaning companies, security companies, restaurants, warehouses, home healthcare companies, and multi-location operators

- Researching qualified leads

- Contacting business owners and managers

- Sending approved outreach messages

- Booking demos

- Helping show the software during demos

- Following up after demos

- Tracking every lead and follow-up in the CRM

- Helping prospects understand pricing

- Helping close monthly subscriptions

- Keeping the pipeline organized



MAIN CUSTOMER TARGETS



We are mainly focused on businesses that can pay monthly and have multiple locations, teams, employees, shifts, or operational problems.



Examples:

- Property management companies

- Cleaning companies

- Security companies

- Restaurants with multiple locations

- Home healthcare companies

- Warehouses

- Staffing companies

- Service businesses with field teams

- Multi-location operators



Our Starter plan is $39/month, but the main sales focus is higher-value customers:

Multi-Location Control: $99 per location per month

Operations Pro: $149 per location per month

Enterprise: Custom pricing



The goal is not just to get many small customers. The goal is to help build monthly recurring revenue.



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Strong English communication skills

- Reliable internet

- A quiet place for calls

- Sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or customer support experience

- Ability to work U.S. business hours or partial U.S. business hours

- Ability to use CRM tools

- Ability to follow instructions carefully

- Ability to write professional messages

- Ability to attend video calls when needed

- Ability to track all activity clearly



BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH



- SaaS sales

- Property management

- Real estate support

- Appointment setting

- Cold

- LinkedIn outreach

- CRM management

- U.S. business clients

- B2B lead generation

- Demo calls

- Customer onboarding



IMPORTANT RULES



- All leads must be tracked in the approved CRM.

- Commission is paid only after customer payment clears.

- No commission is paid on demos only.

- No commission is paid on free trials, refunds, chargebacks, or unpaid accounts.

- Residual commission continues only while the customer stays active and paying.

- Bonuses are paid only after verified MRR stays active for at least 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



Please reply with the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or customer support experience.

3. Your English-speaking experience with U.S. or international clients.

4. Your internet speed.

5. Your available work hours in Philippines time and U.S. Eastern Time.

6. The CRM tools you have used before.

7. A short answer to this question:



“How would you help ShyftGrid get its first 25 paying business customers?”



8. Please include a short video introduction if possible. This helps us understand your communication style.



We are looking for someone serious, organized, and motivated by long-term growth. If you want stable monthly pay plus commission and residual upside, this could be a strong opportunity.

About the Role

37 Projects produces podcast content for health experts, doctors, researchers, and performance brands. From every podcast episode we create multiple assets: full episodes, clips, Shorts, and high-impact trailers.



The trailer is one of the most important pieces of content we produce. It needs to capture the emotional tension, ideas, and story of the episode in a short, powerful format.



We are looking for someone who can design the architecture of these trailers.

This role is not about editing. It is about story judgment.

You will watch the full podcast episode and determine which 
nts belong in the trailer and in what order to create the strongest narrative.

Video editors will then execute the edit based on your blueprint.

• Watch full podcast episodes (1–2 hours)

• Identify the most powerful, emotional, or thought-provoking 
nts

• Arrange the clips in a way that creates curiosity, tension, and payoff

• Deliver a clear timestamp blueprint for editors



Example deliverable:



TRAILER STRUCTURE

0:00 Hook

12:14 – Key provocative idea

0:07 Curiosity 
nt

05:58 – Unexpected question

0:16 Emotional insight

20:56 – Personal reflection

0:28 Thought-provoking idea

17:33 – Key concept

0:38 Closing line



Editors then produce the final trailer using this structure.



You Are a Good Fit If You

• Have a strong editorial eye for storytelling

• Understand pacing, emotional beats, and narrative tension

• Can identify 
nts that make viewers curious

• Are comfortable watching long-form conversations and extracting the best parts

This Role Is NOT

? Video editing

This role is about content judgment and storytelling architecture.

title: Senior SEO Strategist and Team Lead
description:
# Senior SEO Strategist & Team Lead



## About Us



We are a growing SEO agency focused on helping local businesses dominate Google Search, Google Maps, AI Overviews, and ChatGPT-style search experiences.



We are looking for a highly experienced SEO Strategist & Team Lead who can take ownership of campaign performance, rankings, team execution, and SEO strategy.



This is not a basic SEO role.



We are looking for someone who can identify ranking bottlenecks, develop winning SEO strategies, lead our team, and ensure our clients consistently move toward Page 1 rankings.



---



## Your Mission



Your responsibility is simple:



**Analyze every campaign, identify what is preventing growth, build a plan to fix it, and lead the team to execute it.**



You will be accountable for rankings, traffic growth, local SEO performance, and campaign success.



---



## Responsibilities



### SEO Performance Monitoring



* Review client rankings daily.

* Identify ranking drops and traffic declines.

* Identify campaigns that are stalling.

* Monitor organic rankings, local rankings, traffic, clicks, impressions, and conversions.

* Proactively identify opportunities for growth.



### SEO Strategy & Campaign Planning



* Conduct in-depth website audits.

* Identify what is preventing a website from reaching Page 1.

* Develop SEO strategies that drive measurable growth.

* Build and manage 90-day SEO roadmaps.

* Develop:



  * Keyword strategies

  * Content strategies

  * Internal linking strategies

  * Local SEO strategies

  * Authority-building strategies

  * Website restructuring recommendations



### Team Leadership



* Assign SEO tasks to writers, SEO specialists, link builders, and developers.

* Manage projects through Asana.

* Conduct weekly SEO tea
etings.

* Follow up with tea
mbers to ensure tasks are completed.

* Review completed work and maintain quality standards.

* Adjust campaign strategies based on performance data.



### Technical SEO



* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues.



* Conduct audits using tools such as:



  * Google Search Console

  * Google Analytics 4

  * SEMrush

  * Ahrefs

  * SE Ranking

  * Screaming Frog



* Work directly with developers to implement fixes.



* Personally implement SEO fixes when required.



### Client Strategy & Communication



* Conduct strategy calls with clients.

* Explain campaign performance and next steps.

* Present SEO recommendations and growth opportunities.

* Adjust campaign strategies based on client goals.



### SEO Operations



* Build and improve SEO fulfillment SOPs.

* Build and improve GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) fulfillment SOPs.

* Improve internal processes and campaign workflows.

* Ensure campaigns continue progressing and never stall.



## What We're Looking For



* Proven experience ranking websites on Page 1 of Google.

* Strong Local SEO and Google Business Profile experience.

* Strong Technical SEO experience.

* Strong On-Page SEO experience.

* Strong SEO strategy and campaign planning skills.

* Experience managing SEO teams.

* Experience leading weekly meetings and managing project workflows.

* Ability to diagnose ranking issues quickly and create actionable plans.

* Ability to take ownership and accountability for campaign performance.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



You will be measured on:



* Growth in organic rankings.

* Growth in local SEO rankings.

* Growth in organic traffic.

* Growth in clicks and impressions.

* Growth in Google Business Profile visibility.

* Campaign execution and completion rates.

* Client retention and satisfaction.

* Number of campaigns actively progressing versus stalled.

* Visibility within AI search experiences, including AI Overviews and ChatGPT-style search discovery.



---



## Application Questions



1. How many SEO campaigns have you managed simultaneously?

2. Describe a campaign where you took a site from little or no visibility to Page 1 rankings.

3. Describe a local SEO campaign that achieved significant ranking growth.

4. What metrics do you review daily across active SEO campaigns?

5. If a client's rankings have been stagnant for six months, what is your process for diagnosing and fixing the issue?

6. What SEO tools do you use daily?

7. Please provide examples, case studies, or screenshots demonstrating ranking improvements you have personally achieved.



Bonus: Submit a Loom video auditing a website and explaining what is preventing it from ranking higher and what actions you would take to improve its performance.

description:
Real Estate Virtual Assistant — West Coast Living (Oakwyn Realty)

???? Remote | Full-Time | Philippine-Based Applicants | PST Hours (9 AM – 6 PM)





Who We Are

West Coast Living is a top-producing real estate team based in Vancouver, BC, operating under Oakwyn Realty. We specialize in residential resale, presale project marketing, rental property management, and developer-facing listing services. We are a fast-moving, highly collaborative team that takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally.

We are looking for a seasoned Real Estate Virtual Assistant who is ready to grow with us long-term. This is not a general admin role. This is a career opportunity for someone who knows Canadian real estate, speaks the language, understands the systems, and wants to be a real part of a professional team.





The Role

You will be embedded into our team,  attending meetings, communicating directly with agents and clients, and supporting the full transaction and marketing cycle. You will be relied on for accuracy, speed, professionalism, and initiative. If we succeed, you succeed. We believe in recognizing and rewarding the people who show up and deliver.





What You Will Do

Transaction & Listing Support

Prepare, organize, and track listing documents including MLS input forms, Schedule A/B addenda, and BCREA contracts

Enter and update listings on Paragon MLS — including photos, room measurements, strata details, and listing remarks

Manage document collection and completion checklists for active listings and buyer files

Maintain accurate records in the team CRM (Reach)

Prepare showing feedback summaries and market update reports for clients



Administrative & Operations

Draft and proofread client-facing
s, letters, and follow-up messages in a warm, professional tone

Prepare and manage web forms, online applications, and digital document submissions

Maintain team calendars, schedule showings, and coordinate appointments

Research properties, strata documents, title histories, and building profiles using online tools

Source and verify information from BC Assessment, Stratapress, Strata Plan Registry, and other public records

Support presale marketing files including unit trackers, price lists, and developer correspondence



Communication & Team Participation

Attend team meetings via Zoom or Google Meet (PST hours — 8 AM to 5 PM Monday to Friday)

Communicate responsively via WhatsApp and
 with team members and clients

Flag issues proactively — if something is missing, unclear, or time-sensitive, you speak up

Support the team lead with personal organization, task tracking, and project follow-up





What You Need to Bring

Non-Negotiable Requirements:

Minimum 2–3 years of real estate experience — either in a Canadian real estate office, with a Canadian real estate team, or supporting a Canadian broker or agent remotely

Solid working knowledge of Paragon MLS — including listing entry, status updates, and photo uploads

Familiarity with Canadian real estate forms, terminology, and transaction stages (Accepted Offer, Subject Removal, Completion, Possession)

Fluent written and spoken English — your
s, documents, and verbal communication must be professional and clear

Advanced skills in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Calendar) and Dropbox

Experience with web forms, digital documents, and e-signature tools (DocuSign or similar)

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy under pressure

Reliable internet with minimum 25 Mbps upload/download — you must provide your speed test result

Backup internet plan for outages (mobile hotspot, nearby café, or generator) — tell us your plan



Strong Assets:

Experience with Canva for real estate marketing materials

Experience with presale project marketing or new development real estate

Familiarity with BC real estate specifics: strata, depreciation reports, Form B, PTT, FINTRAC

Proactive with technology — you don't just use tools, you suggest better ones

Experience supporting a team lead or broker in a client-facing real estate environment





Work Setup & Availability

This role works Vancouver time (Pacific Standard / Pacific Daylight Time) — Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. This is a hard requirement. Our clients and our market operate on this schedule, and you will be expected to be present and responsive during these hours.



We will ask you:

What is your current internet speed? (Please include a screenshot of a recent speed test from fast.com or speedtest.net)

Does your city/area experience frequent typhoons, power outages, or weather-related disruptions?

What is your backup plan if your primary internet goes down? (Mobile data, nearby café, generator — please describe)

We have experienced connectivity issues with previous VAs during weather events. We take this seriously and expect an honest, detailed answer.





Who Thrives on This Team

You are organized to the point that other people notice. You communicate before you're asked. You read a document all the way through before responding. You notice when something doesn't add up. You are proud of the quality of your work and you take ownership of your file like it's yours.



You want to build something — not just fill a role. You are looking for a team that will invest in you and give you room to grow. You are not looking for a side gig. You are looking for a career.





How to Apply — Read This Carefully

?? Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your subject line must read exactly: "WCL VA – [Your Name] – I Read the Whole Thing"

Any other subject line tells us you did not read this ad.



Step 2 — Your Application

In the body of your application, answer the following in order:

Briefly describe one real estate transaction or file you supported from start to finish — what was your role and what happened?

List every MLS system or real estate software you have used and how long you used each

What is the difference between Subject Removal and Completion in a BC real estate transaction? (Answer in your own words — do not Google this. If you know Canadian real estate, you know this.)

What is your internet speed and what is your backup plan for outages?

What city are you located in, and does it experience typhoons or storm-related outages? How do you handle this?

Tell us one tool or process you introduced in a previous role that made the team more efficient



Step 3 — Attachments

Your application must include:

Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

A portfolio or work sample — this can be a Canva design, a document you created, a spreadsheet you built, or any piece of work that shows us the quality of what you produce. If you do not have a portfolio, create a short sample — a listing description, a formatted table, a one-page summary of anything. This is your chance to show us how you work.

A screenshot of your internet speed test (from fast.com or speedtest.net)





Compensation & What We Offer

We pay for skill, experience, and reliability — not the lowest rate we can find. This is a long-term role and we compensate accordingly.



Base Rate:

$9.00 – $11.00 CDN per hour, full-time (40 hours/week), based on experience and demonstrated Canadian real estate knowledge.



What's Included:

Competitive base rate reviewed after your first 120 days

Performance-based increases — if the team grows, your compensation grows with it

13th month bonus (paid annually — this is a standard we honour without exception)

10 paid days off per year

A stable, long-term position with a professional and supportive team environment

Direct access to the team lead and agents — you are not working in isolation



We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the right person. If you bring the skills, the professionalism, and the commitment — we will take care of you and grow together.





What to Expect

Qualified applicants will be contacted for a short written screening, followed by a video interview over Google Meet. We move quickly with candidates who demonstrate they are the right fit.



This is a long-term role with a team that takes care of its people. If you are serious about real estate, serious about quality, and ready to work hard alongside people who will do the same — we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) – AI Workflows for Law & Medicine – Full-Time, Remote (Philippines Only
description:
Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) – AI Workflows for Law & Medicine  

Full-Time, Remote (Philippines Only)  

Salary: USD $1,500.00 - $2,000.00 per month (depending on experience and portfolio)



Job Overview  



We are a U.S.-based personal injury law firm in Washington State focused on traumatic brain injury and other serious injuries. We are building AI tools for real work in medicine and law, not consumer apps or marketing sites.  



For clinics, our platform is designed to help general practitioners and specialists access the kind of insight you would normally need many specialists for—so they can better understand complex cases and make more informed decisions for their patients.  



For law firms, our platform supports lawyers who represent injured people by organizing complex medical and legal information and highlighting hidden errors in how insurance companies and their examiners handle claims. The goal is to make it easier to present clear, evidence?based cases when large insurers try to underpay or deny meritorious claims.



If you want your design work to support professional users whose efforts improve the lives of those they serve —doctors and lawyers—and contribute to more informed decisions and fairer outcomes, this is the kind of product you’ll be helping shape.  



Our AI engineer is already building the core workflows and intelligence. We are now looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) from the Philippines who can turn these ideas into a clear, trustworthy, and easy?to?use product suite. This is a full-time, long-term remote role for a designer who wants to own the product experience end?to?end.



Responsibilities  

- Lead the UX and UI design for two interconnected AI products:  

  -  A clinical support interface for neurologists and other specialists, surfacing multi?specialty insight in a way that feels clear and safe to use in real practice.  

  -  A legal workflow platform that helps trial lawyers see patterns in insurer behavior and IME usage, and build stronger, evidence?based cases.  

- Translate complex, expert workflows into clear, step?by?step user flows and wireframes for clinicians and lawyers (many of whom are new to AI tools).  

- Design high?fidelity screens and interactive prototypes in Figma for core flows, dashboards, document views, and decision support.  

- Create and maintain a design system (components, typography, color, spacing) that expresses credibility and professionalism while staying modern and efficient.  

- Design intuitive onboarding, empty states, and guided flows so users understand what the AI can do, how to interpret its output, and where their own judgment is needed.  

- Collaborate closely with the AI engineer and firm owner via Zoo
et, Loom, and async tools.  

- Iterate based on feedback and basic user tests, focusing on clarity, speed, and reduction of cognitive load for busy professionals.



Requirements  

- 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer / UX/UI Designer working on web applications or SaaS products (not just marketing pages or social media graphics).  

- Strong portfolio showcasing:  

  -  Complex tools or dashboards made simple and straightforward to use.  

  -  Clean, modern UI for professional or B2B users.  

- Expert in Figma (components, auto?layout, variants, and prototyping).  

- Solid understanding of UX fundamentals: information architecture, interaction design, hierarchy, and usability.  

- Strong visual design skills: typography, spacing, layout, and color, with an eye for calm, trustworthy interfaces appropriate for medicine and law.  

- Comfortable writing and speaking in English and explaining your design decisions to non?designers.  



Philippines-only: You must be a Filipino citizen residing in the Philippines.



Nice to Have  

- Experience designing for healthcare, clinician tools, medical records, or decision?support systems.  

- Experience with legal, case?management, or other professional services software.  

- Familiarity with AI/ML products, data?heavy interfaces, or knowledge?base/search tools.  

- Basic understanding of front?end implementation (HTML/CSS/React) is a plus, but not required.



Salary & Work Schedule  

- Full-time (40 hours/week), long-term.  

- Salary: USD $1,500 - $2,000 per month, depending on experience and portfolio.  

- Work hours are flexible, but you must be able to join overlapping calls with U.S. Pacific Time for a few hours each week. Our lead AI/ML engineer in Manila now works in the US time zone.



How to Apply

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



1. Subject line:  

   “Senior Product Designer – AI Law & Medicine – [Your Name]”



2. Short cover letter/message:  

   - Briefly introduce yourself.  

   - Tell us about one project where you simplified a complex, expert workflow (e.g., medical, financial, legal, data-heavy, or B2B).  

   - Share why working on AI tools for doctors and law firms appeals to you.  



3. Portfolio link (required):

We are hiring several people for this role.

(2) Send them via our logistic platform discovery sets of our products.

Account size ? Your commission per order

title: Video Producer - Remote
description:
About Us

37 Projects is the #1 Video Podcast Marketing Service for Health & Performance Brands. We manage every step of the process - from editing and publishing to strategy, branding, and growth - so our clients can focus on recording while we handle the rest.



We are looking for a Production Manager/Creative Director/Head of Production - Video - Remote who will elevate the creative direction of our clients’ podcasts and YouTube channels. This role blends branding, storytelling, and execution. You’ll ensure that every piece of content reflects the client’s brand identity while engaging audiences at scale.



Role Overview

This role is primarily responsible for the creative direction and production quality of YouTube Shorts, podcast trailers, and explainer videos.



The majority of creative weight sits on:

1. Designing high-impact podcast trailers (not editing)

2. Directing Shorts for maximum engagement and retention

3. Guiding explainer-style educational content to be visually and structurally strong



This is not a passive oversight role.

This is a hands-on creative production leadership role.



The person in this role must think like a:

- Producer

- YouTube-native creative strategist

- Short-form content director



Primary Responsibilities (Highest Priority)

1. Podcast Trailers – Full Ownership

You are fully responsible for:

- Watching full podcast episodes

- Selecting the strongest, most emotionally engaging segments

- Structuring the trailer intro

- Designing the creative arc of the trailer



This includes directing:

- What parts to highlight

- Where to cut

- Where to place B-roll

- Where motion graphics should appear

- Where sound effects enhance emotion

- Audio emphasis and pacing



You do not just approve the trailer - you guide the editor step by step on how it should be executed.



The trailer must:

- Hook within seconds

- Represent the core value of the episode

- Feel premium and intentional

- Increase click-through and retention



2. YouTube Shorts – Creative Direction & Optimization

This is a major focus of the role.

You are responsible for ensuring:

- Strong first 3 seconds

- Aggressive but clean removal of filler words

- High visual rhythm

- Optimal length (40–60 seconds sweet spot)

- Strong narrative even in short format



You will:

a) Guide editors on:

- Cuts

- Visual pacing

- Zoom levels

- Subtitle emphasis

- Motion graphics timing

- Icon use

- Sound design

b) Review Shorts before approval for:

- Engagement strength

- Clarity

- Visual polish

- Platform-native feel



The Shorts must feel:

- Fast

- Intentional

- Emotionally sharp

- YouTube-native



3. Educational / Explainer Videos

For explainer-style content, you are responsible for:

- Ensuring visuals support learning

- Confirming that B-roll accurately reflects what the speaker is explaining

- Eliminating generic or misleading visuals

- Maintaining clean information hierarchy

- Making sure the video enhances clarity, not confusion



You guide editors on:

- Where diagrams appear

- When on-screen text supports key points

- When to stay minimal

- When to emphasize



The explainer must feel:

- Structured

- Educational

- Visually coherent

- Strategically paced



Secondary Responsibilities

4. Deadline Awareness & Delivery Discipline

You must ensure:

- Trailers and Shorts are delivered on time

- Video Specialists understand publishing schedules

- Content calendar awareness is integrated into production

If an editor is late:

- You escalate early

- You reprioritize correctly

- You protect publishing consistency

This role has authority to:

- Flag delays

- Push editors when needed

- Enforce prioritization



5. Training & Coaching Video Specialists (Creative QA)

Not the primary weight — but important.

You will train QA to check for:

- B-roll relevance

- Subtitle quality

- Animation timing

- Icon consistency

- Audio-video sync

- Overall creative coherence



The goal: Upgrade QA from “spelling checkers” to “creative quality reviewers.”



6. Client-Specific Editing Guidelines

You will create editing guidelines per client, covering:

- Trailer style

- Shorts pacing

- Explainer structure

- Animation usage

- Caption systems

- Brand-specific do’s and don’ts

These ensure consistency across editors.



7. Asset Development & Reusability (Lower Priority)

In collaboration with a strong After Effects editor, you will:

- Develop reusable motion graphic packages

- Build icon animation systems

- Create lower-third templates

- Build visual systems for Shorts

Assets will be:

- Built in After Effects

- Stored centrally

- Reusable across editors

This supports scale and consistency.



Authority & Positioning

This role is:

- A creative production leader

- A Shorts and Trailer specialist

- A quality guardian

- A production-level decision maker

This person has influence over:

- Video Editors

- Video Specialists

- Creative standards

- Delivery priorities



This role is not administrative. It is strategic and execution-focused.



Success in This Role Looks Like

- High-performing YouTube Shorts

- Stronger trailer retention and click-through

- Clear, structured explainer videos

- Fewer creative revisions

- Faster production cycles

- Stronger brand consistency across clients



How to Apply

Please fill up this form:

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Node + React) - Long- Term, Full-Time, Real Estate Tech Startup
description:
ABOUT US

We are building a new kind of real estate platform in the United States. It is called The Buyer Listing Service.

Today, real estate websites only show homes that are for sale. We are building the buy side of the market for real estate agents. On our platform, real estate agents post buyer want-listings, not for sale listings. Our system then uses AI to match both buyer agents and seller agents together. We work directly with the official real estate databases (called MLSs) that agents use across the US. More of these databases are signing up with us every month and we're growing fast. 



We are a small and fast-moving team. When you write code here, it ships quickly and real people use it. This is a rare chance to help build a brand-new product from a growth stage, take real ownership, and grow with the company.



THE KIND OF PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an experienced engineer who can work independently. Over time, you will own and run large parts of this platform. We are relying on your expertise. This is not a junior role and we are not looking for someone we train from the basics. If you need a senior developer checking all of your work, this is not the right fit. If you want real ownership and the chance to be the technical expert on a growing product, it is a great fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Build and improve features across our website and our backend API

• Review and merge code changes (we use a clean pull request workflow on GitHub)

• Connect and clean real estate data from different sources so it fits our system

• Use AI tools (like Claude) to help map and clean messy data

• Work closely with the founder and one other developer, and increasingly own your areas

    

YOU MUST HAVE

• 4+ years of professional full-stack experience, and the proven ability to work on your own

• Strong fundamentals, not just frameworks. You can explain how JavaScript works (for example, the event loop), how the web works, and how to model and query a SQL database.

• Strong skills in Node.js and Express

• Strong skills in React

• Comfortable writing raw SQL (we use MySQL, no ORM)

• Real experience integrating and cleaning messy data and APIs from other systems

• A habit of learning on your own. You have personal projects or things you built to teach yourself.

• Clean Git habits and small, focused pull requests

• Good written English (most of our work is async and in writing)

• Able to follow written rules and instructions exactly



HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI

We use AI tools like Claude every day and we want people who use them well. But we are hiring an experienced engineer, not a person who copies and pastes from a chatbot. You should be able to explain why your code works, and fix it when the AI gives a wrong answer. In our process we will always ask you to explain your decisions, so deep experience matters more than fast answers.



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with AWS

• Experience using AI or LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) in real projects • Experience with data pipelines or ETL



HOW WE WORK

• We write small, focused changes. We do not refactor code that is not part of the task.

• We follow a written set of rules for the codebase. Following instructions matters more here than working fast.

• We welcome AI tools. We want people who use them well to do more.



HOURS

Full-time, 40 hours per week. We would like you to work US East Coast hours if you can. This helps you work at the same time as the rest of the team.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this post.

2. Send a link to one project you built and are proud of. Tell us in 2 or 3 sentences what it does, what part you built, and why you built it that way. Be ready to explain your choices on a call.

3. Tell us your experience with Node, React, and SQL, and the largest project you have owned or led.

4. Tell us if you have used AI or LLM tools in your work, and how.

Our process is a short call, then a deeper technical interview, then a small paid task using fake data, then a short call to walk through your code together. We will reply to strong applicants.

We are seeking a motivated and results driven Sales Closer to join our growing team.



In this role, you will be responsible for speaking with interested leads, answering questions, and guiding qualified prospects through the enrollment process. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals with strong communication and sales skills who enjoy working in a performance driven environment.



Responsibilities

• Contact newly registered leads through a call.

• Explain our service and answer questions professionally.

• Guide interested prospects through the next steps.

• Follow up with leads when necessary.

• Record call outcomes and maintain accurate notes.

• Meet performance and conversion goals.



Requirements

• Ability to speak English with a clear American-sounding accent.

• Previous experience in sales, customer service, telemarketing, or BPO is preferred.

• Own computer or laptop with a high quality audio setup.

• Stable and reliable internet connection.

• Strong communication and objection handling skills.

• Professional call etiquette.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.



Job Details

• Remote position.

• 8 hours per day.

• 40 to 48 hours per week.

• Flexible schedule based on business needs.



To apply, kindly submit:

• A brief summary of your relevant experience.

• A short voice recording introducing yourself in English.

• Your availability and preferred working hours.



We are looking for confident communicators who are comfortable speaking with prospects, handling objections, and helping interested leads make informed decisions.

title: UFO Compilation Video Editor
description:
I'm looking for a video editor for my YouTube channel featuring UFO sighting compilations. I provide the video clips, and you handle the rest — writing the narration script, generating the voice over, and editing everything into a finished compilation. Ideally you already have (or are willing to get) paid Claude and ElevenLabs subscriptions, since you'll use Claude for the scripts and ElevenLabs for the voice over.



The style should be clean but transformative — channels like AFO 
 and Sky Watch TV 
 are good reference points. Each compilation is about 10 minutes long (8-10 clips, roughly 4 hours of work), and I produce about 3 per week, so this is steady, ongoing work.



My budget is $20 per compilation. The channel isn't monetized yet so I'm keeping costs lean, but for the right editor this becomes a regular gig with high monthly volume.



To apply, start your message with the word ORBS so I know you actually read this, and include your portfolio plus 1-2 samples closest to the style above. From the strongest applicants I'll invite a few to a quick test — editing the first 3 minutes of a sample clip — before we begin the regular ongoing work. Thanks!

title: Executive Assistant for U.S. Immigration Lawyer & Law School Director
description:
Professional

Type: Part-Time | Fully Remote | International Candidates Welcome

Hours: Approximately 20 hours/week

Compensation: $6/hour

Time Zone Requirement: Availability to overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) during core hours



About the Principal

You will be supporting a San Francisco-based immigration attorney, federal litigator, law school director, and university lecturer whose work spans multiple high-stakes professional environments simultaneously.



His current roles include:



Director & Staff Attorney at a newly established federal immigration litigation clinic filing habeas corpus petitions in U.S. District Courts, supervising law students, mentoring pro bono practitioners, and fundraising.

Founding Attorney of a premier San Francisco immigration law firm handling complex cases including asylum, removal defense, business and investor visas, family-based immigration, and federal habeas corpus petitions, with a multilingual staff and an outstanding client reputation.

University Lecturer teaching advanced legal research and writing to graduate law students.

ESL Instructor teaching literacy-level students, many of whom are immigrants and refugees.



This is not a routine administrative role. You will be supporting a principal whose daily work involves federal court deadlines, law student supervision, client emergencies, grant writing, academic course management, and community outreach — often all in the same week. The right candidate will take ownership of key administrative and operational systems so the principal can stay focused on high-level legal, academic, and strategic work.



Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Calendar & Communications



Own and manage a complex, multi-context calendar spanning court deadlines, academic commitments, client meetings, and community engagements

Triage incoming communications by urgency and context; draft professional correspondence on behalf of the principal

Proactively flag scheduling conflicts, deadline overlaps, and risks before they arise



2. Legal Clinic & Academic Administration



Track litigation docket deadlines, court filing windows, and student clinic milestones

Assist with logistics for conferences, CLE events, and practitioner training sessions

Support grant research and reporting: tracking deadlines and organizing submission materials

Coordinate between the principal, faculty colleagues, clinic students, and pro bono practitioners



3. Law Firm Operations



Liaise with the firm's internal team to ensure smooth daily operations

Support client intake workflows: organizing forms, tracking missing documents, and following up

Assist with digital marketing: maintain content calendars, coordinate post scheduling, and track engagement across social media platforms

Help maintain organized digital case file systems across firm platforms



4. Academic Course Support



Organize and upload course materials including syllabi, rubrics, and lesson plans across learning management platforms

Manage student communications, deadlines, and logistical updates with sensitivity to multilingual populations



5. Research & Special Projects



Conduct preliminary research on assigned topics and prepare concise briefing summaries

Support community-facing writing projects including articles and public-facing content

Adapt flexibly to shifting priorities as needed





Required Qualifications



3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Manager, or Project Manager — ideally supporting a principal with multiple concurrent professional roles

Exceptional written and spoken English with the ability to draft polished professional communications

Tech proficiency across Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, project management tools (Asana/ClickUp/Notion), and AI productivity tools; legal practice management software experience is a plus

Strong organizational instincts — comfort managing competing deadlines across entirely different professional contexts

Reliable overlap with US Pacific Time during core working hours



Preferred Qualifications



Prior experience supporting attorneys, law firms, or academic institutions

Familiarity with immigration law workflows or federal court processes

Experience working with or teaching ESL/multilingual populations





What You'll Gain



Exposure to federal immigration litigation, legal clinical education, and law firm operations at a high level

A mission-driven environment serving immigrant communities

100% remote flexibility from anywhere in the world

Competitive part-time compensation commensurate with experience





How to Apply

Please submit the following with the subject line: EA Application — [Your Name]

Your resume or CV

One writing sample demonstrating your professional written communication skills (if available)

title: URGENT: Launch Project Manager & Social Media Recruiter (45 hrs/wk - Shift Aligned to AST)
description:
Job Overview

We are launching a new, niche mobile application specifically designed for women aged 35–60. We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and efficient Social Media Recruiter and Project Coordinator based in the Philippines to lead our 30-day beta testing phase.



Our immediate goal is to recruit and individually manage 200 female beta testers before our testing kickoff on June 17th. The live app market launch will follow 1–2 weeks later. You will also be assisting with the preparation and details for that.



?? Important Workflow Note

This is NOT a community moderation or public group management role. There will be no private forum or group interaction. Instead, testers will participate individually. You will be responsible for sourcing them on social media, onboarding them 1-on-1, and tracking their individual submissions via standardized feedback forms. 



Salary & Compensation

Month 1 (Launch Phase): $8 USD per hour at 45 hours per week (Full-Time).



Month 2+ (Post-Launch): Transitions to a stable, long-term Part-Time role at 20 hours per week at the same hourly rate, managing ongoing social media growth and promotions.



Payments are processed weekly via Wise.



Shift & Schedule Requirement (Strict)

The founder works on Atlantic Standard Time (AST) from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM.



Because of the 11-hour time difference, you must be able to work your hours within this window to co-ordinate efforts and participate in a daily alignment call.



Depending on your exact setup, this will require you to work a primarily evening, overnight, or early morning shift in the Philippines. Please only apply if you have a proven track record of maintaining an overnight/US-aligned schedule without issues.



Your Core Responsibilities

Your Core Responsibilities

Targeted Social Recruitment: Hunt for, reach out to, and recruit our target demographic (women 35–60) using channels like
/Facebook Groups, Reddit, Instagram, YouTube, and Pinterest.



1-on-1 Beta Coordination: Onboard the 200 testers individually and utilize our structured milestone incentive program to keep them independently engaged across the full 30 days.



Data & Milestone Tracking: Log, monitor, and ensure individual testers submit their standardized feedback forms at critical intervals (Days 1, 3, 5, 7, 14, and 30).



Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of hands-on sourcing, outreach, or project coordination experience using at least 3 of these platforms:
, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, or Pinterest.



Skills: Elite written English skills. You must know how to communicate authentically and professionally with a mature, Western female demographic.



Traits: High organization, data-driven mindset, ability to handle high-volume 1-on-1 direct messaging, and excellent spreadsheet tracking habits.

Requirements

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of hands-on marketing, sourcing, or community-building experience on at least 3 of these platforms:
, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, or Pinterest.



Skills: Elite written English skills. You must know how to communicate authentically and professionally with a mature, Western female demographic.



Traits: High organization, ability to juggle multiple conversations at once, and a creative approach to overcoming recruitment roadblocks.



The Incentives You Will Be Pitching to Testers

We make your recruitment job easier by offering excellent rewards to the participants:

*A chance to win a $200 Amazon Gift Card upon completing the test.

*6 months of free premium app usage once we go live.

*A secondary chance to win a $300 Amazon Gift Card for remaining active at the 6-month mark.

*Bonus draw entries given for every single feedback form they submit (Days 1, 3, 5, 7, 14, and 30).



How to Apply 

If you are highly organized, love a challenge, and can start right away, please apply through the platform with the following exact steps:



Use the exact subject line: Beta Testing Job

Include 2 very specific examples of your relevant experience in social media outreach, individual project coordination, or data tracking.

Use the word volunteers somewhere in the body of your message so we know you read the whole post.

Explicitly indicate if you are available to start right away and confirm you are comfortable with the evening/overnight AST schedule alignment.

If selected, we will provide further confidential app details for you to review before you commit, followed by a quick Google Meet or Microsoft Teams video call.
